svg.title: Editable reconstruction of multi-panel recurrent propagation framework diagram

g.desc: Origin is the top video volume; downward direction contains divide arrow, timeline, feature extraction columns, RP-I and RP-II propagation chains, upsample modules, and output frames. Horizontal symmetry is based on evenly spaced temporal columns.

g.desc: Origin is leftmost F_i-K feature block; propagation proceeds horizontally to the right through K preceding features, then downward to RP-I fed by Y_i and producing F_i. The layout is horizontally chained with vertical input-output symmetry at RP-I.
Origin is leftmost M_i-2K block; the dashed red chain accumulates 2K preceding features into RP-II with F_i side input and M_i output. The top sequence is evenly partitioned horizontally.

Origin is the K preceding feature stack on the left. Upward/rightward flow sends aligned features to MFCA; downward flow combines with Y_i at CMF, then outputs F_i. The upper-right dashed inset is a legend for MFCA and CMF. Symmetry is flowchart-like with parallel horizontal arrows and vertical fusion link.
Legend contains FE, U, propagation arrow, RP-I/RP-II modules, and translucent layer-I/layer-II buffers.
